basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old IT professional living in Portland, Oregon. Diagnosed with Celiac Disease a few years back, I've since embarked on a journey to better understand dietary restrictions and how they affect health. Outside of work, I love dabbling in DIY tech projects and have a soft spot for animal crossing games. When I'm not at my computer, you might find me hiking the beautiful trails of the Pacific Northwest or experimenting with gluten-free recipes in my kitchen. My online hours are usually in the evenings, and I'm currently single, which gives me more time to explore my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science and a career in IT, I have a strong foundation in technology. My knowledge of Celiac Disease and dietary intolerances comes from both personal experience and extensive self-research. I frequently engage with online communities to exchange information and stay updated on the latest research.
